title:
7 Nutrition Myths
Keeping You Fat
After 40

items.headline: Myth: Your metabolism is shot after 40.
items.body: Most of the slowdown is muscle loss, not age. Protein and lifting bring it back.

items.headline: Myth: Carbs make you fat.
items.body: Excess calories make you fat. Rice, potatoes and oats inside your target don't.

items.headline: Myth: Fat makes you fat.
items.body: Testosterone is built from it. Drop below 20% of your calories and your hormones pay.

items.headline: Myth: The harder you cut, the faster you win.
items.body: Starvation deficits burn muscle, crash hormones, and the weight comes right back.

items.headline: Myth: The scale tells the truth.
items.body: It tells half of it. Gain 2 lbs of muscle, lose 3 of fat, and it says one. Track your waist too.

items.headline: Myth: A few beers don't count.
items.body: Seven calories a gram, burned before fat, and it tanks testosterone and deep sleep.

items.headline: Myth: Skip the yolk.
items.body: Don't fear the yolk. It's not 1987.

cta.headline:
Stop Guessing.
Start Tracking.
body: The Long Game: the macro manual for men in transition.
